info.title: jsnet
info.description: The jsnet command-line tool: compile, run, check, emit and format JS.Net code, and host the JS.Net language server. Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.

commands.name: compile
commands.description: Generate C# for MSBuild (used by JSNet.Sdk)

commands.name: emit
commands.description: Print the generated C# (what Roslyn compiles to IL)

commands.name: fmt
commands.description: Format code with the native (Rust) jsnet-tools formatter

commands.name: lsp
commands.description: Start the JS.Net language server on stdio

commands.name: run
commands.description: Compile in memory and run (no project needed)

commands.name: server
commands.description:
Run (or stop) the build server used by JSNet.Sdk
info | --version               Show version information
